surface: Waypoint component and position constants at react-waypoint 10.3.0, with vertical/horizontal geometry, offsets, ancestor selection, and rapid-crossing callbacks. Node-suite pristine/adapted runtime and repo-authored type lanes are registered with react-parity:check; the Karma browser suite remains deferred.
divergences: Public node and prop types use Octane structural types and do not import React.

Upstream browser Karma suite is not yet adapted; scroll-geometry parity remains incomplete until that lane lands. See UPSTREAM.md.
ssr: Supported. The marker renders on the server and measurement/listeners begin after client mount.
